title: Cogitate experiment 1: suprathreshold stimuli of variable duration
purpose: Test divergent preregistered predictions of GNWT and IIT about where conscious content is represented, how it is maintained over time, and which areas synchronize.
steps: Participants viewed suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts for 0.5, 1.0 or 1.5 s, task-relevant or task-irrelevant, while recorded with fMRI (120), MEG (102) or iEEG (34).
known_limitations: Visual consciousness only. Interpretations were agreed with the theory proponents in advance.

sources.quote: Human participants (n = 256) viewed suprathreshold stimuli for variable durations
